title: CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY — blocks all writes during build
expected_feedback: Critical: Plain CREATE INDEX acquires ShareLock, blocking all writes for the entire index build on a 12M-row table. Use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, which takes ShareUpdateExclusiveLock and allows concurrent DML. Second critical issue: SET LOCAL outside a transaction block emits a warning and has no effect, so this migration currently has no lock_timeout at all -- either wrap the plain DDL in BEGIN/COMMIT, or use session-level SET for the CONCURRENTLY form.
